description: Read one gig: its state (open | awarded | in_progress | pending_verification | verified | cancelled), pay, mode, poster, awardee, every offer, and the escrow it holds (held from post until the payout is paid, released at payment, refunded on cancel), and whether it is paid. The gig id is its task id, so /task/<id> and the task:<id> wall are the same work.

gig_id.description: the gig id (= its task id)
